Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET based on the supplied existing comic attack illustration (identity/style/action reference). Exactly FOUR consecutive frames of ONE attack: horizontal sword sweep. Layout: 2 columns x 2 rows, full canvas1536x1024; each frame768x512 landscape. Reading order top-left,top-right,bottom-left,bottom-right: anticipation/preparation; wind-up/charging; strike/release with energy; follow-through/recovery. Pose3 matches the reference action. Draw actual anatomical arm and weapon movement between poses, NOT four duplicate stills with different particles. For archery show string draw then release, arrow flying to RIGHT and relaxed draw hand. All characters face/attack RIGHT as reference. Same hero identity, face, exact armor/costume/weapon, palette and detailed inked comic rendering in all4frames. Same camera, scale and torso anchor in all4frames (torso around x300,y300 within every cell). Keep whole silhouette/effects within each frame with at least40px transparent padding on all edges. No cutoffs, no crossing frames. No grid lines, labels, text, floor, scenery. Truly transparent RGBA background. Do not reproduce the reference background or opaque glow. Energy wisps are allowed, separated by transparent space. Capes/hair follow arm motion. One character per frame; weapon stays held. Preserve crisp detailed comic art, NOT chibi or pixel sprites. All four frames equally sized.
CRITICAL PRODUCTION CORRECTION: previous sheet overflowed cell boundaries. Draw figures AND effects MUCH SMALLER: whole silhouette MUST fit in a 480x300 rectangle centered inside EACH 768x512 cell, leaving at least144pixels blank alpha left/right and106pixels top/bottom. The empty gaps are REQUIRED, do not fill the canvas. Each cell center at384,256; keep torso anchored similarly across frames. No scattered debris/leaves/particles outside that box. Short compact trails only. Keep the weapon and released arrows INSIDE the480x300 box. Four miniature detailed comic cutouts surrounded by wide empty alpha margins. Do not use art from neighbouring cells. Do NOT zoom in or enlarge subjects. Use precise equally spaced 2x2 grid. TRUE TRANSPARENCY.
